name: @dafuga01/offline-sync
description: Framework-neutral IndexedDB response caching and durable offline mutation replay.

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts --target browser --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run audit
